texts.title: Maple Street Dental Practice — new patients

paragraphs.text: Maple Street Dental Practice is accepting new patients. To register, please complete a registration form, which you can download from our website or collect from reception, and bring it to your first appointment together with a list of any medicines you take.
The practice is open from 8 am to 6 pm on weekdays and from 9 am to 1 pm on Saturdays. Emergency appointments are kept free every morning; please phone as soon as we open.
If you cannot attend an appointment, let us know at least 24 hours in advance. Patients who miss two appointments without telling us may be removed from our list.
Parking is available behind the building, and there is a bus stop on Maple Street, just two minutes’ walk away.
Children under 18 receive treatment free of charge. Adults pay according to the treatment they need, and a full price list is available at reception and on our website.
